As ASAPP's former CTO and president of technology, Vijayarajendran brings three decades of AI and software leadership at global enterprises including Microsoft, IBM and SAP. "Our goal at ASAPP is clear - to be the industry leader in AI for contact centers," said Priya Vijayarajendran, CEO of ASAPP. "Achieving our goal means advancing our best-in-class products, and helping our customers quickly realize the measurable economic and goodwill value of our offerings. ASAPP is uniquely positioned with the talent, domain expertise, technology, and momentum to make our goal a reality, and I'm proud to lead our unmatched team."
